e: Explain one environmental disadvantage of frequent device replacement. [3 marks]
Creates electronic waste and uses energy/resources in manufacture.

Privacy, informed use/consent or biased profiling, with contextual explanation.

Faster cheaper access for connected households; excludes families without dependable devices/internet.

stretch.task: Introduce a third output for a family that prefers telephone contact.
stretch.hint: Add a second condition such as needsCall.
stretch.answer: Online true -> app; online false and needsCall true -> phone; else paper.

mastery.task: Design a three-method communication chooser using internet access, accessibility need and urgency, then test cases for exclusion.
mastery.hint: Define priorities and test mutually conflicting preferences.
mastery.answer: Example: no internet+urgent -> phone; no internet+nonurgent -> paper; internet+accessible -> app; inaccessible app -> accessible alternative. Explain algorithm limits.
